_comment: The tier definitions for the function-calling diagnostic arm (docs/PROTOCOL.md).
One difference from tiers.example.json, and it is not cosmetic: gpt-5.6-terra runs with
reasoning_effort 'none'. This gateway's /v1/chat/completions refuses function tools together
with any other reasoning_effort ('To use function tools, use /v1/responses or set
reasoning_effort to none'), and the text arm ran that tier at 'high', where 63.3% of its output
tokens were reasoning. So this arm's terra is a cheaper, weaker configuration and not the same
comparator wearing a different protocol. A like-for-like terra under function calling needs
/v1/responses, which this harness does not speak.
claude-fable-5 needs no change: it accepts function tools as configured.

self_hosted.rate_basis: measured 2026-08-29 on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8, g6e.12xlarge at $15.2174/h, TP=2 x 2 replicas. fresh_in from 18,417 prefill tok/s aggregate at 16 in flight; cache_read from 224,620 tok/s of cached prefill measured the same way, which is 8.2% of a fresh token (benchctl/cached_prefill_rate.py). cache_write priced as fresh input because the engine does the same work to populate a block as to compute it. THIS REPLACES the earlier $10.68 flat rate, whose basis said prefix caching is unsupported on the hybrid attention layers -- that was a missing opt-in flag rather than an architectural limit, so the old rate priced every repeated prompt as recomputed and overstated the box input rate by about 45x.
